detailed_descriptions.en: Welcome to the supernatural world of Ghost Town , a single-player puzzle adventure VR game by Fireproof Games, creators of the widely acclaimed game series ‘The Room’. HANDS-ON EXPLORATION From the opening prologue set in a haunted Theatre, Ghost Town will draw you into its immersive world of 1983. With a controller in each hand and a torch to light your way, explore a variety of atmospheric locations and overcome tactile puzzles, cast spells and even summon troubled spirits to move them on to the next world. MEET A CAST OF INTRIGUING CHARACTERS Interact with a variety of expressive characters brought to life with precise motion capture and professional voice acting to tell the engaging story of Edith Penrose, a gifted ghost hunter who runs a paranormal detective agency. DISCOVER INCREDIBLE LOCATIONS From the unreliable lift of a London tower block to the rusted ruins of a remote lighthouse, the locations of Ghost Town are filled with authentic details, ancient artifacts and jaw-dropping vistas. BEGIN AN EPIC ADVENTURE After the mysterious disappearance of her brother, Edith’s world is turned upside down. Her desperation for the truth takes her to a remote Scottish island in the hope a gifted clairvoyant can provide some much-needed answers, though nothing can prepare Edith for what she will find. Fireproof Games are a small independent team based in Guildford, UK. Ghost Town is the result of over 4 years of development and we hope you enjoy playing it as much as we enjoyed making it.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Welcome to the supernatural world of Ghost Town, a single-player puzzle adventure VR game by Fireproof Games, creators of the widely acclaimed game series ‘The Room’.

HANDS-ON EXPLORATION

From the opening prologue set in a haunted Theatre, Ghost Town will draw you into its immersive world of 1983. With a controller in each hand and a torch to light your way, explore a variety of atmospheric locations and overcome tactile puzzles, cast spells and even summon troubled spirits to move them on to the next world.

MEET A CAST OF INTRIGUING CHARACTERS

Interact with a variety of expressive characters brought to life with precise motion capture and professional voice acting to tell the engaging story of Edith Penrose, a gifted ghost hunter who runs a paranormal detective agency.

DISCOVER INCREDIBLE LOCATIONS

From the unreliable lift of a London tower block to the rusted ruins of a remote lighthouse, the locations of Ghost Town are filled with authentic details, ancient artifacts and jaw-dropping vistas.

BEGIN AN EPIC ADVENTURE

After the mysterious disappearance of her brother, Edith’s world is turned upside down. Her desperation for the truth takes her to a remote Scottish island in the hope a gifted clairvoyant can provide some much-needed answers, though nothing can prepare Edith for what she will find.

Fireproof Games are a small independent team based in Guildford, UK. Ghost Town is the result of over 4 years of development and we hope you enjoy playing it as much as we enjoyed making it.
